issues: No attempt to get around the measurement. There is no file or network access and no pasted coordinates. All randomness comes from the seeded rng passed into _darts. The radii are computed, not hard-coded: the 0.11/0.06 bimodal target sizes are only a starting point and are shrunk as needed.

No bug that would make the result meaningless. The _darts loop always ends, because after every 200 failed throws all target radii shrink by 10%, which keeps making placement easier. The dart radii are only used as SLSQP starting values. The packing is still checked and repaired afterwards, so validity does not depend on _darts.
Minor: the first SLSQP step now starts from the dart centres, so INIT_LOW is no longer used in this branch and may be dead code.

Plausibility: the candidate's single adjusted value of 2.9396 is above the published best of about 2.9370 cited on the card. The gap of 0.0026 is within one noise sd (0.0034) of the adjusted value, so it is not evidence of cheating. A replicate is still needed before any claim that the published best has been beaten.

Recomputed z: the gain is 0.0030. Using SE = 0.0034*sqrt(1/1 + 1/2) ≈ 0.00416 gives z ≈ 0.72. This matches the harness's 0.713; the small gap is likely rounding. With one candidate run the gain is not significant, so the provisional reject is consistent with the numbers. The candidate is a reasonable one to run again.
